Description Why do I NEVER EVER EVER EVER see the players that I commend on my team in consecutive matches? My experience with the Dota 2 matchmaking system in 2025 has been astronomically abysmal. I went down in MMR from 6400 to 5200 now and it keeps getting worse and worse and worse. It's the same downward spiral pattern every time. I win one game with good players, I commend them all and - POOF- they're gone! Removed from the player pool for my matchmaking algorithms! But what do I see on MY team ALWAYS? Players that have been muted before. Players that slipped out of the avoid list because I put others in there. Players that I DEFINITELY clicked the Dislike button on - and that button seems to be a MAGNET for assigning them to my team. And then I lose 3 games in a row. I win another one. I lose 4. I win once more. And lose 5 matches. Again and again and again it keeps happening. Good players one game, no complaints, no toxic bullshit, 4 commends, and IMMEDIATELY after that game - you guessed it: premuted teammates. At least in 3 games in a row. WHY can't it EVER be the people that I just had an enjoyable game with? WHY does matchmaking insist to PUNISH EVERY SINGLE HARD-EARNED VICTORY by assigning me griefers (who grief in subtle ways that won't net them Overwatch penalties, of course) directly after that victory?? 8/10 of my matches, THIS IS NOT AN EXAGGERATION 80%, are of absolutely ABYSMAL quality, no matter what the Dotalabs prompt shows before game start regarding predicted match quality. The whole "smart" algorithm that is supposedly meant to improve match quality is some pathetic joke. I've played this game since 2012 and this year has been the WORST experience I've had with it BY FAR. I cancelled my Dota plus because it's just a pointless system and a placebo. You avoid 4 griefers; 12 more take their place. More often than not the same ones that you've pushed out of your avoid list by adding new ones. I highly suspect the commendation/dislike system is also just a placebo. ### Example Match ID (and possibly Timestamp) _No response_ ### Screenshots _No Description Because of electricity outages in my home, my behavior and communication score in the game is being reduced. Can you please help me solve this problem? I can’t use voice chat in matches, so I can’t communicate with my team, and I’m going crazy from the silence. In my games everyone stays silent, and if I’m lucky, someone might type something in chat. Could you please raise my behavior score at least back to 8000 so I can use my microphone again? I have never been toxic in the game, I was even silent on purpose just to improve my behavior score. But other players form parties and report me for no reason just to boost their own behavior score, and I can’t do anything about it. I try to play Turbo to climb out of this nightmare, but now I fell from 7500 to 5900 again. I don’t understand how this system even works, it hurts my head. In a team game, we all stay silent and just do different actions without being able to discuss a plan, because the system lowers my score and blocks my communication. I beg you, can you raise it back or at least let me play with teams that actually communicate and play normally? Right now, I constantly meet people who ruin games for no reason, who go feed, and I can’t even understand why they do it. My mental health is collapsing. I wouldn’t be writing this message if I wasn’t playing the game regularly. Please give me a way out of this hell. At the very least, make the behavior score increase faster, or disable the party-report system in some modes. Otherwise, party players will keep reporting for no reason to boost their own score, while I can do nothing against it. ### Example Match ID (and possibly Timestamp) _No response_ ### Screenshots Just Description At the moment, when queuing exclusively for Turbo mode, you only gain 150 Comms Score points if you get a perfect summary (0 reports after 15 matches). In Normal mode/Ranked mode, you gain 300 Comms Score points if you get a perfect summary (0 reports after 15 matches). This is a mathematical error on Valve's part. For example, lets say you put aside 4 hours to play Dota on your day off from work. If you queue for Normal/Ranked AP, with each game lasting 60 minutes on average, that means you played 4 games. And with 9 other players in each of those games, that means you can potentially be reported by 36 trolls (worst case scenario). But... if you queued exclusively for Turbo mode during those 4 hours of Dota, that means you played 8 matches (with each game lasting 30 mins on average). Which means you could potentially be reported by 72 trolls (worst case scenario) compared to when queuing for Normal/Ranked mode. So if you're queuing exclusively for Turbo mode, not only are you only gaining half as many Comms points per summary (best case summary with 0 reports), you're also risking getting twice as many reports because you are playing twice as many matches compared to Normal/Ranked mode. So to put things right mathematically speaking, Valve needs to change the system so that Comms reports only count as half a report each (compared to Normal/Ranked mode). Or alternatively, allow Turbo mode players to gain the full 300 Comms Score points per perfect summary (15 matches with 0 reports). Otherwise, Turbo players risk their Comms score falling into deficit twice as fast as Normal/Ranked players. guys, I think there is a serious issue with the current Dota 2 Behaviour System and how it is implemented, I will try to give as much relevant and detailed information as possible to explain why I think so and what can be done in order to change that. I do not use github's issue report system and I am not entirely sure what is the best way to present the issue's details and context so if the information is not presented properly, please explain to me how I can I present it to you in a better way. I will separate the main information into several sections. I also am not sure since technically this topic is covered in multiple such similarly named issues if I should go there instead of writing a new issue and if I should please point me to the correct one to post to. 1. Who am I and why do I think my opinion should be considered seriously? - I am a somewhat long term and consistent player with a lot of Dota 2 games played so you can say I have proper experience and knowledge to somewhat "objectively" explain my opinion why the current Behaviour System does not seem to work correctly. If it matters I am also a constant Dota+ member and I buy most of the extra released content at least at the base level available. - I will not reveal personal details in the post but if a Dota 2 team member would like verification of who I am and if the information I provide is valid, you can contact me and I will share that information. 2. Why do I play Dota 2? - I play Dota 2 because I think it is a great team based online game and I find it or at least found it fun to play (most of the time). It simply has a good gameplay system which is fun and allows for a good way to spend your time and to compete in a battle of wits and experience with and against other players. I prefer and mainly play Turbo mode due to their speed, ability to test different builds and heroes and to get the full potential of any hero easier and also because it lessens the psychological burden of "bad" game due to objectively toxic people like the different kind of griefers. abusers and self saboteurs. 3. What kind of person and player am I? - I am player that wants to have fun, do challenges and genuinely try to win the game. I never have or will grief a game just because I am in a bad mood or want to "punish" innocent people. Although I have to admit that maybe I have "griefed" games depending on what the community and my personal definitions of griefing is. For example is griefing or pinging a griefer objectively griefing. From what I have read technically yes because it somehow "promotes" or "reinforces" the toxic behaviour. Personally I do not agree with this point of view because I do not think it is either morally, objectively or practically correct for several reasons but I am willing to accept it and I have somewhat accepted to agree with that. But here is from where I think part of the problem lies, as far as I know (and if I am wrong please send me a link) there is no actual clear definition of what behaviour or actions can be considered griefing with proper examples. Everything relies on the premise that the players have morality, common sense and would not report out of just feelings alone. Do not get me wrong, I know what should be considered proper but I will present you with an in-game example of a game I played for which I most likely got banned and you be the judge if I was banned for a viable reason. 4. What the problem is? - The main problem is that the current Behaviour System in my opinion is not working properly and even bans people unfairly due to volume of reports rather than an actual valid reason for a ban. I do realise there must be some kind of protection against just mass reporting but it I dont think it is working properly. 5. My previous and current general experience. - I used to be at a constant or nearly constant 10.000 behaviour score and I even had the ability to view Overwatch games and judge them. And after a certain update / point of time which I cant remember or pinpoint accurately (but can probably be determined by looking at the game history). I am not sure how fast exactly but my behaviour score started to fall and I reached "1" after some time. Then I managed to climb to 4.xxx then fell (currently) to "1" again and got another 1 day ban and simply had enough, went to Steam support and they sent me here. Some of initial fall from 10 to 1 in behaviour score might have been "rightfully" earned due to me "griefing" and griefing in a way that can be considered valid for a ban - for example feeding a "Divine Rapier" or something of the sorts after someone objectively griefed me or managed to provoke me enough for me to want to just end the game as fast as possible. I am not claiming I was or am perfect but the amount of games I ever "fed a rapier" or such can probably be counted on a person's hands while I have more than ten thousand Dota 2 games and I have grown wiser to grief in such a way (or grief at all, depending on what you consider griefing). My main point is, I dont even grief in any way at all (at least by my standards which I will explain in more detail below), I try to play the games to the best of my capacity even with griefers in it and still my behaviour score falls a lot faster than it rises and I get bans which from what I have observed basically amounts to lower behaviour score amounting to easier bans due to mass reporting coming from other people at low behaviour score which most likely do it out of spite even if they havent been provoked or griefed. 6. What do the game developers, community and me personally define as griefing? - I do not know either what the developers or other parts of the community deem to be considered griefing but at least I can give you my opinion, behaviour and examples and you can decided for yourself if my point of view is skewed or somehow the general notion of fair and unfair is being skewed. I will give you my opinion on it with examples below. 7. What is currently worst behaviour and can it be / should it be considered as griefing? Here are several things and examples of what can be considered "griefing" done by me, considering by the highest moral standarts (which shouldnt be the highest because such moral standarts are undeserved and simply impractical to execute by a normal player faced with a genuine abuser or griefer and would otherwise amount to basically defending the abuser from any retaliation from a victim and by extension punishing the victim and encouraging the abuser): - I REALLY want to highlight that I (almost) never (like 99,999% of the time) do not start a negative behaviour be it pinging or else towards a team mate, and I am not using this an excuse for negative behaviour, I am saying that if I ever ping items or levels or else it is always in retaliation of someone else that does it or has done it multiple times which in most cases is them falsely pushing blame ( and I do really mean objectively falsely, because I check if it was my fault and if I have done everything in my power considering the situation to help them and check if the blame is genuinely mine. If that is ever the case I either say sorry or keep my mouth shut. - I do not feed rapiers or similar behaviour, maybe in a somewhat recent game in which one invisible team mate simply stayed on the lane without any contribution, leeched xp (thus actively gave our opponent on the lane a level advantage while destroying ours) and did not even help in team fights in front of him I did buy 2-3 Dusts and left them under our tower, I want to clarify that everyone (the enemy or our team) can pick the dusts (including the "afk" team mate) and the dust can be considered a support item given to our team against their so yeah I have walked the "grey" line in this manner and I do not think I should regret it or should be punished for it. - My communication and "pinging", before when I started falling from 10, yes I admit some of that fall the same as the rapier most likely was deserved because I did ping an item multiple times or the similar. And by the way to clarify I dont think I have ever genuinely insulted or abused anyone in chat (at least I dont remember doing so), even though I have had a team of players literally saying they will rape my mother and etc. So consider how fair is that. My current "pinging" which by the highest perfect moral standards can be considered toxic is in retaliation to other people pinging me for either illogical things (for example vision and warding all while I have been warding everywhere the whole game but the person did not pay attention at all and went for the only place the enemy just dewarded) or me seeing how they deflect blame from themselves. And for example because even if I wanted to ping like a madman (which from quite some time I neither want or am interested at all) I cant simply because of the 30 second chat restriction so the worst "chat abuse' or negative behaviour is to ping a "Mantle of Intelligence" 4-5 times during a game, again in most cases either in retaliation but I have to admit it was several times due to the plain stupidity and deflecting of people - for example a Shadowfiend mid that dies several times in a row the same way on an unwarded mid and then he tells someone else or me for example to buy another entirely unrelated or not useful item. And the other thing is probably giving a few mantles to such people when I can already see the game is most likely going to be a loss due to our team being outfarmed, beaten and biting at each other and I still have no way out without being punished for leaving the game and eventually banned because of multiple leavings, so yeah judge me for those mantles as much as you want, it is easy when you are not in my shoes. - So now the interesting and truly grey grey line at least in my eyes, from which I refuse to not "morally" defend my position which I will even give a recent game example below. I guess the ultimate way to never EVER be griefed or reported or reported like 1-10% of the time only due to plain spite would be if you ALWAYS bend over to the demands of your team mates no matter if they have the objective right - be it farm or lane or otherwise. Which in my opinion is simply morally corrupt and sick and I dont think should be considered the right thing, for the very least it truly promotes toxic behaviour because the toxic people get what they want all while other players cant or have to wait a lot of time to play whatever role or hero on whatever lane or way they want which in my opinion goes and should go directly against the spirit of Dota 2 which allows a person (at least not in a ranked and not a "role" based game mode like Turbo) to play whatever and however they want ( with the exception of simply solo feeding multiple times by only their own fault and purposeful griefing by extension of it). 8. My recent game example that convinced me to finally come here and speak my mind. The straw that finally broke the camel's back for me is my last game that got me a 1 day ban and now with 3-5 single draft games I need to win yet again, after I had a ban just 1-2 days prior and just crawled out of the low priority pool just to be sent there again. This game simply removed all self doubt in that the problem might be in me and convinced me that there is something wrong with the current behaviour system. So what happened in the game and did I do anything "objectively" wrong. - Well what happened was that I selected mid first and decided to play a "Crystal Maiden" and yeah, yeah I know what you are thinking - the Maiden isnt a mid hero and even on mid afterwards isnt that useful even in Turbo and yada yada - I know but that isnt the point, the point is that it is a Turbo public uncoordinated game in which not one of the 10 people have any responsibility towards anyone in the game to play a certain way other than just [;ay to win the game. This isnt about what is mechanically right, it is about the freedom of players to play what they want (and I do not mean feed or grief) but simply play what they want to the best extend they can even if it is just for testing or experience, as long as they actually do play the game. And do you think that I invented that idea or the idea of other supports doing that, no and I havent judged or pinged anyone for it even though I have objectively seen it being the main reason for losing a game or reducing the win probability by a large amount. It has the same effect as picking 5 supports or 5 carries on 1 team or doing an "Invisible 1 hp Terrorblade Sunder build" and almost anyone reading this can understand why it is "technically" is a problem but in practice is a right for any player to do as long as they do not purposefully grief the game. By the way I want to clarify, I basically try to play every hero and with different even quite not standard builds and I am not exactly a Crystal Maiden mid spammer, so it is not like I do the same "bad' thing over and over again to lose and get reported. It something I decided to give a chance to, I dont only do "non standard" builds, I think I play the normal builds most of the time and adapt a few items depending on the situation so it is not like I am plain defending going against the game's "best way to play", I just dont think it is objectively right for people to be able to mass report , be it people on the same or enemy team and ban a person due to them playing a certain way or trying a new thing. And I am sure that ultimately that is how the system works at least at 1 behaviour score - if you get too many reports from different people even if you havent griefed the game you simply get banned which is part of why the whole system seems wrong and proves that in the end of the day it is a tool for people to simply report people they dont agree or like even if those people arent wrong or objectively deserving for a ban. And I will below in a moment what I mean exactly. I will explain the whole game to the end because I think the whole context is needed. So what happened - I picked the lane first and the hero, then another person came to mid , there is no way to "roll dice" for the position or determine who gets it fairly so I personally respect the rule of whoever is first and want to play that lane gets it and under these circumstances I think it is objectively the right thing for everyone. And if I ever am the second person for mid I simply move away and do not contest it and I think that is how it is supposed to be done by everyone cause otherwise there is no way to determine it fairly. Then the other person simply did strange things from the start (they were at least by stats an experienced player) - like feeding the enemy, then walking back from base then staying under the tower doing nothing looking like they were completely AFK just to leech XP even when the second player on the enemy side left and there was only 1 person on the enemy side, then I pulled creeps towards this person so they can die and be moved and they moved and simply proved they were there and their intention was to intentionally grief the lane from me, the same thing happened in the jungle and so I responded accordingly - made sure I last hit my creeps on the camp I first came to and I think even 1 time when I passed through them last hitting theirs. I dont think that is griefing or wrong, for the very least they already costed me a lot of my own xp and gold. Then come the team fights and etc, ultimately the person did not help even our other teammates and I think by extension for example of not ulting to help them and etc griefed them. So basically it was 100% sure that they simply griefed the whole game out of spite and in the end I, the person that played and tried to genuinely win the game by doing what generally should be done to win a game like being focused the rest of the time on team fights and warding even while being leeched out of XP and gold, which directly affected my items and the enemy's items which directly affected my ability to play and not countered or countering the enemy's item and ultimately making my hero more useless not just because it is in the "wrong" position but because it has even less from what it needed to have at that point. And in the end we lost (If it matters I still had a better K/D/A than the griefing person) and since I was to blame by the "mob" mentality of my teammates and the power given to them by "the Dota 2 community to regulate itself" I got screwed and banned. And how I know that most of them if not all of them reported me - well if not by the ban itself, it was because during the game 1 teammate was already muted from another game (most likely by being one of those toxic people by default), I had to mute another due to them starting to spam ping me because they simply took the side of the AFK griefer and most likely just reported me and I am almost sure that the rest of the players simply reported me just because I was playing a Maiden on mid no matter if I was griefing or not. So yes, by this simple direct example of possibly many more I can say that the current system needs serious correction because it simply shows the big underlying issue of the whole system - that the core premise of "self regulation" is basically giving the toxic players or envious players a tool to ban an otherwise legit player that mostly did nothing wrong other than defend their position. 9. What I think can and should be done big or small to improve the current behaviour system? - The very least give the ability even for behaviour score 1 muted players to be able to roll for a position on a lane, that will resolve a lot of internal issues. - Detach communication score from behaviour score completely, it is illogical and contra productive to even consider that both things should be tied together in the first place. I guess that is done to simplify the system but it is incredibly detrimental to the point it actively makes the game worse and more toxic for everyone - it does not allow players that have never even abused chat in the first place to be completely muted and being able to communicate to your team in some sort of way better than 1 ping in 30 seconds is important for team play and game play and can literally lead to lost games and even more toxicity - I am sure that there are a lot more than one game but I personally clearly remember one in which I pinged an item the realised that the enemy team is in front of us, could not ping anything, our team got destroyed not knowing the whole enemy team was there and we lost the game. - Improve the current player rating system - Commends basically mean nothing and I think I know why you have done it this way - because of people who swap commends, well I guess the solution is somewhat "simple" - make "swap commends" in profile names or otherwise a bannable offense since it actively ruins the point of positive feedback between players either for the sake of positivity or for the sake of the behaviour system to be able to determine non-toxic from toxic players. I know that because I think I have one of the better game to commend rations amongst the general player base and I have never swap or begged for commends and yet I am here deemed a "toxic" player worthy of a ban. After that I personally do not see a way for people to actively coordinate swapping commends and thus by extension people will respect the commend system a lot more and you will be able to use it to help calibrate the behaviour system. - If not soften the negative then at least empower the positive report system so it isnt so hard to climb up, in some people's eyes this might make the report system less effective due to toxic players having the ability to more easily climb up but I personally do not think that is the case - a truly toxic person will have a lot of a harder time to climb up if they do not stop the purposeful toxic behaviour and a person that can at least control themselves and work with other people will have an easier time and not be stuck with the toxic people which by itself feeds an empowered negative feedback loop that by the current's system's design of weighting negativity a lot more than positivity means that it empowers the reports out of spite and people get punished but cant be rewarded for their normal, positive behaviour even if it outweighs the negative one by a lot more. - Add a basic rule from the sorts of "Whoever picks the lane first or rolls higher gets to play the lane and the position they want and the other person should go otherwhere.", since that would be the fairest way to determine who should have the right to a contested lane or position and add breaking of such a rule towards the severity of the report, for example if a person legitimately was the first on the lane they should be exempted from retaliation from the second person and the second person should be more liable for a punishment. - By enforcing such rules like the above one and eliminating any possible legit contesting of another person's position you can then by extension determine real griefers and people rage baiters from the rest of the community. When such people are eventually manually reviewed - issue more severe warning to those that refused to follow a basic respectable order and if they continue to do so start banning them for 1, 2 months. And also do not punish or punish a lot less severely the people that respond towards another person's unprovoked toxicity (by the way I do not view myself as being a rage baited person, I just think that responding to toxicity in some way is fair and should not be punishable otherwise if you completely ignore a person some people would consider that toxic and that you are griefing by ignoring people, I personally am quite past the rage part, it is just that when you are stuck in a surely losing game in which you know by the items, team K/D/A, coordination and etc of both sides that it is truly a 99% loss and you have nothing better to do because you can neither farm or afk (because you might get the automatic AFK penalty) or do anything else, one of the best past and personally justifiable past times is to respond to the griefer by at least making them feel bad and making them realise that they are the problem. It might not sound right and it is not like I really like it myself but put yourself in my position or most people in my position - what are you supposed to do, you cant concede, you cant afk, you cant do anything except literally pretend that you are playing while just waiting and wanting for the game to end. - Simply add a "Concede" option. I just read a short Chatgpt summary of why there isnt one yet. And with all due respect to you but you are dead wrong and completely backwards. It isnt about "Comebacks Are Always Possible", that sounds cute until you have been subjected to the actual objective reality. The reality that even if "Comebacks Are Always Possible", that "Always" is like 1% and even impossible if there are actual griefes on your team, yes I have also won 4v5 or 3v5 games but that is not the point of all this. Any long enough term player knows that a game can be won even by 1 single player doing the right thing at the right time - for example a ratting Shadow Shaman can win the game. But that would be 1 game out of 1000 in which they lost meanwhile all while they struggled and suffered in all the rest of those 1000 games. And that one win doesnt even fully feel like a win because all the while you won, you also carried the griefers and gave them a free win. The point is that you deliberately stick normal people with genuinely toxic and unhinged people assuming the second either do not exist or the situation is not that bad. Trust me, it is. And you rely on this 1% and excuse all this abuse and toxicity because of that. It is neither fair or right. - Try resetting once or add some kind of annual reset of the behaviour score system. This way if there are any truly undeserving people at the lowest part, they'll probably stay afloat or at least for longer and the truly toxic people will fall again. Although if the system remains exactly the same I have some doubts that it wont simply completely fail again. - Make either a detailed guide or even a simple rule book of what behaviour should be considered griefing and at what point. For example at what point in a Turbo game a "carry" jungling and not helping in team fights should be considered griefing - 1, 2. 3 times? Because I can tell you from my personal experience even 1 time in Turbo is enough to lose the entire game but if we should be justly lenient - if a person does not partake in team fights 3 times all while they have had the ability and resources to do so, that should be considered griefing and should be an "objective" reason for other people to report that person. That is a detailed example and a simple rule book one would be - "whoever picks a lane first gets to play it and pick their own position first". - By the way I want to mention that from what I have seen the "Overwatch" and the penalties given either directly lie to the player or do not tell the full truth, and I know it by the simple fact that I have gotten immediate bans that claimed to be "Overwatch" bans during or after a game I played while I know there is no way for an actual person to have observed and judged the game already in the first place (at least if Overwatch reviews work the same way when I was able to give them). If it is true that it is not so, I dont think it is appropriate to send messages with lies towards the players since it shows an unwillingness to put basic effort for clarity and respect into the in-game ban messaging system. I hope the Dota 2 development team is able to understand how bad things really are and why - a long term, consistent player is starting to consider quitting the game because it is becoming (literally) unplayable. A person that dislikes to write on forums to come here and write such a large post. I think that fixing the behaviour system as quickly as possible is more imperative than even any content update. I hope I managed to list and explain everything properly. If I forgot anything or have another idea I will try to add to it. This post is made with all the respect towards the efforts of the Dota 2 developers and the Dota 2 community. Thank you for this great game, but please fix this issue. Description # Feedback & Suggestions: Dota 2 Report and Behaviour System The current Dota 2 report and behaviour system feels unfair and easily exploitable, especially for players with behaviour scores below 6,000. Here are the main issues and suggestions: ## Issues Observed - **Difficulty Recovering Behaviour Score:** Once a player drops below 6k behaviour, it becomes nearly impossible to recover, even with consistently positive gameplay. - **Unfair Reporting:** Players often get reported despite carrying games and maintaining good conduct, sometimes simply for being muted or for no clear reason. - **Lack of Action Against Real Trolls:** Players who intentionally ruin games (e.g., staying in the jungle AFK for 20+ minutes in Turbo) rarely get banned, which encourages toxic behaviours. - **Abuse of Reporting:** Many players report anyone who is muted or disagrees with them, regardless of actual behaviour or performance. This creates a cycle of mass reporting. ## Suggestions for Improvement 1. **Limit Reports:** Remove infinite reports; instead, allow only one report per played match. 2. **Restrict Reporting from Toxic Players:** Players who have been recently reported should temporarily lose the ability to report others. 3. **Automate Warnings & Low Priority:** Automatically place players who remain AFK in the jungle or refuse to help their team into low priority after repeated offenses. 4. **Incentivize Cooperation:** Add incentives for positive teamplay and show behavioural/skill improvements after every match. 5. **Preserve Communication:** Do not remove communication entirely; allow players to choose who to mute, as teamwork is essential in Dota 2. 6. **Improve Reporting System Moderation:** The current automated reporting system is unfair. Introduce some form of AI review or at least human moderation to validate reports and prevent abuse. **Summary:** The current system punishes the wrong players and emboldens toxic behaviour. A few targeted changes could make the experience fairer and more enjoyable for everyone. Description There is a reason why LOL 5x'd its player-base while Dota on march break had a declining trend of players. The average game experience as of a year ago feels worse than it ever did. The devs over complicate matchmaking and behavior systems that have repeatedly done more harm than good. As a consequence of not retaining players, queueing at certain times leads to insanely long queues in many regions, and suggestions from the community keep being ignored. Some intent is needed on making the core experience better, not adding tangential minigames. Marketing the game also more appropriately for the kind of prizes on tournaments also makes more sense, and not going silent for years while ignoring glaring issues the community raises. Yes there is a fear of smurfs but valve is already doing nothing about it. A yearly ban does NOT cut it. Moreover, high profile previously banned players like Mason are still playing the game and streaming it. Implement significantly more harsh deterrents Punishments currently are a complete joke. They dont deter nor do they even come close to any sort of reform. Taking away post game drops and coaching... seriously, does any player on earth care about this? ranked temp bans should be a thing, or forcing players to play 200 regular games to re access rank. 3 strikes and a temp ban should be the norm and a fourth being a permanent ban. Valves fear of smurfs and banning their toxic cash cows has made new players less likely to stick around and stifled the games growth at the peril of other players. Give players also a visible warning when their behavior is being reported at a high rate (textbox that cant be dismissed or something of the sort). This used to be a thing in DOTA, and is no longer. Also single draft was a fun game mode, now its dead since its the default LP mode. If you want players to go over a more painful experience, make them play a match at 0.5x speed. Commends mean absolutely nothing, and there are no good incentives for behavior: Solution. Rework commends into having meaning and impact. Implement a scaling behavior system visible to other players. Say 12k behavior score is the average, it is far too often you see toxic players in it, clearly there are better behaved players within 12k than others. So break the cap above 12k to lets say 20k BUT it gets progressively harder to mantain any score above 12k. You can tie higher BS to actual rewards players would be happy to recieve. If you give players one or two endorsement votes at the end of the match to use on players they enjoyed playing with you can generate a system where actual good behavior can stand out. To be in lets say 15k you'd be getting endorsed every other game, above 17k every game, some gradient like that. The endorsement system similar to the Blizzard Overwatch and LOL was very effective, they have used it for more than 10 years. Endorsement level can be a visible medal, and should be rewarded when high. Currently 12k behavior means nothing now, too many toxic players on whats supposed to be the highest behavior bracket. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mudd1HKKLWY De-centivize knee jerk inaccurate reporting With more accurate data you can make better decisions. Anyone that reports for EVERY CATEGORY altogether should have its reports ignored. Encourage players to report accurately. Thank players for using overwatch and notify them when action is taken. Spam reporters should be taken less seriously AND they should know about it. If a players report everyone in a match there is no credible reason to take them seriously for the next one unless they start reporting with intent. The current system gives the illusion of multiple reports and has some measures for spam reporting, however they simply take the first report at face value. Example, games where the enemy team stomps (and losses in genera) usually lead to cores being reported, you see this all the time in overwatch and is exacerbated by smurfs being able to ruin lower rank games. Description I've been playing Dota since the original Warcraft 3 days, and after transitioning to Dota 2, I’ve accumulated **3,647 hours purely for entertainment** since 2013. Also **i have almost 5k commends**. However, the introduction of behavior and communication scores has been a significant blow to the enjoyment factor—essentially a modern-day censorship tool. Over the past couple of months, my **communication score has gone into a complete freefall**, to the point where I am now practically unable to interact in any way. I can somewhat understand why, as I didn’t always stay silent when something needed to be said. However, I actively tried to improve—**reducing my communication, staying positive**—yet my score kept dropping, even accelerating into a nosedive. So I have to ask: **Have you actually thought this algorithm through?** At this point, what else is left to sink further? Should I start drawing inappropriate symbols on the minimap? Am I using **"Well Played" at the wrong moment?** Because even with **zero communication**, my score keeps plummeting. For future improvements, here are some suggestions to align with the current system’s trajectory: - Tie the ability to play the game directly to a **social credit score** - Make it possible to **achieve a negative communication score** - If the algorithm dislikes a player’s **avatar or username, apply instant penalties** - Randomly impose **5-second silences or movement restrictions** on heroes - Simply **remove all communication from the game**—GTA V found success this way! - And most fittingly for today’s world: **Allow players to buy their redemption with money**, just like in the good old days when people could purchase absolution for their sins. Let's be honest—this system is **fundamentally flawed**. Scores should improve by simply playing and avoiding bad behavior, yet here I am, **unable to interact in any way, and my score still plummets**. At this point, everything depends entirely on whether other players **report me or not**. And considering how absurdly **toxic Dota has become, players will report for literally anything**. So what exactly is my path forward? Since I **can’t communicate at all anymore, my fate is essentially sealed**. This system has **predestined me to a perfect zero score**, ensuring I will never be able to communicate in Dota again. **At this point, should I just uninstall and let the algorithm send me a thank-you message for improving the community?** **Once upon a time, the worst thing in Dota was getting fountain farmed for 10 minutes. Now, it's getting permanently silenced by an algorithm.** I can only assume that in the future, **players will have to submit a monthly apology essay** to maintain their communication privileges. If this is truly how the system is meant to function, then at least **be transparent** and **officially confirm that once a player’s score is low enough, recovery is impossible**. Because right now, **that’s exactly what’s happening**. I would like to immediately note that this request has been sent to steam support more than once, but due to the peculiarities of their work, and more specifically, the fact that their task is not to help people, but to send bot unsubscribes, I have to contact you on this site. I also need to inform you that my English is not so good, so the appeal will be in two versions, in English and in the original, so that all participants can make the translation themselves. So I would like to discuss one of the most important and oldest issues of dota 2, namely the defective and even malicious reporting system. As you know, the developers have been refusing to fix their unsuitable system for ten years now, once in dota 2, there were no denunciations of users at all, but since this system was introduced, there has been no benefit from it, but only pure harm. This happened because the managers at steam and valve, both before and now, did not want to spend extra money on creating any suitable system, and instead made a primitive report counter, and some time ago, in order to further reduce costs, they installed an even more harmful service of the so-called “patrol”, shifting its direct responsibilities to community members. Let's figure out how this system works for an ordinary member of the dota 2 community. Previously, when there was no system and the first time after the release of dota 2, the community was quite acceptable, this is due to the fact that at first dota 2 was not so easy to get, also because the brand was not yet so widespread, the first members of this community , there were mostly people who transferred from the first version. These were people of an older generation, and if they were young, then at least a little educated, after some time, when dota 2 became available to everyone, the community was immediately flooded with people who began to poison it. These people don’t care about anything other than their egocentrism, and the opportunity to spoil other people, every day they go from match to match and spoil others’ leisure time, everyone who has been in the community for a long time can confirm this, and no attempts by the developers to correct this (it should be noted that what’s wrong They really tried) didn’t help. What did the developers propose to combat violators, so they introduced into dota 2, the most primitive complaint counter, it works on a quantitative principle, that is, the more complaints a person receives, the more guilty the system considers him and, of course, immediately punishes him. If earlier (even before the system), a person could receive punishment if he left the match, now he can receive punishment for anything, literally for everything, even if he did nothing reprehensible. The only criterion for punishment is the number of complaints, the system does not even try to check these complaints (with such developers this will not happen for the next million years), and after numerous requests from people on various forums, the developers added their greatest invention for saving money, “patrol”. It would seem that that’s all, all the issues have now been resolved (as the developers probably thought), but no, everything has worsened. It turns out that now some members of the community are empowered to judge others, this is an interesting micro class system within the community. Some unknown people, not subordinate to anyone, and not controlled by anyone, now have the right to decide whether a person is guilty or not, and keep in mind that these “judges” themselves do not bear any responsibility for their actions, they can hand out fines to people with complete impunity, and no one checks them themselves. This is an interesting question that everyone must answer for themselves, and these same people from the “patrol”, are they so decent, they check complaints as expected, look into each individual case, look for who started the conflict, and whether the complaint is true, how long they spend to decide whether to punish a stranger, whom they don’t care about, or not, or they just hand out fines to people according to their mood, spending a minimum of time on it, asserting themselves at the expense of others and at the same time considering themselves the arbiters of justice. And even that’s not all, as it turned out, in many cases the messages that “after a recent match, the patrol service admitted your guilt” are lies, why do you ask, because steam and valve are standards of decency, they don’t deceive people, so why, such messages come either after some time, this is if there was an inspection, or they come immediately after the end of the match in which the “patrol” found the person guilty. It should be emphasized that the “patrol” service checks the matches in the recording, that is, only after the match ends and the recording is uploaded to the server; moreover, the inspector still needs time to download the match. Here it turns out that the match has not yet ended, and complaints have already been sent to the “patrol”, which entered the match in real time (which has not yet ended), checked the complaints there and issued a punishment, this is how the guys work, everyone is jealous, but in fact this is just nonsense. Of course, no one checks the matches in real time, and the fine is still issued by a defective system. This is how it happens: if a person has received one or two complaints, then after a while, the patrol may check them, or maybe not, and the complaints go into a common piggy bank, when filled, the person receives the same message, supposedly from the “patrol”, but if three or four complaints are received against a person at once, then in this case the system instantly issues a block for half an hour to a day, or maybe more, after which a false message comes about a “patrol” check. At the end of the search block, the person is given a matchmaking restriction, called low priority or in common parlance LP, which generally depends on the initial block, if it lasted half an hour, three hours or so, then 1 restriction, and if more then three or more. Now let's figure out why such fines are issued. As previously stated, any person can receive these restrictions, regardless of whether he is guilty or not. The patrol either does not check complaints at all, or checks at random, but the defective system is designed only to hand out fines, it turns out that ten years later, the same system issues fines simply based on the number of complaints. If a person is in a team of singles, then it is unlikely that everyone else will complain about him (unless this is an egregious case); if a person is in a team consisting of two groups, then the likelihood of receiving a fine increases slightly, and most likely the person will receive a fine for several such matches, as complaints will accumulate, but if a person is thrown into a team with a group of four, then in most cases he will be given a ban immediately after the end of the match. Well, as it seems to you, there is a group of 4 people, they have been playing dota 2 for a week, and they themselves, intentionally or not, are ruining the match, and in the place with them in the team there is another person who, regardless of what, will simply become for them a scapegoat, well, they won’t send complaints against each other, but then a person turns up and let him be the only one who does something in the match, let him drag them along, they don’t care, they will complain about him, and the defective system will issue him a fine. Many, of course, will say “if you don’t like it, go to the rating, there is a search without groups,” well, yes there is, and this rating (which the developers also did in maximum economy mode, and accordingly it is not working) has many of its own problems, and there is still the same system, which, if not for one match, then for several, will still send a person a fine. It turns out that no matter what mode a person goes to, the unified defective reporting system will still give him a fine. Also, in addition to reports of “obstruction,” there are also reports of “toxicity in the chat.” Recently, in dota 2, statistics called “decency” and “politeness” have appeared, the quality of selected matches, the drop of any gifts after the match, and so on depend on the first, the ability to chat mainly depends on the second. This is a rather large topic to fully discuss here, so we will only discuss a few points. It turns out that if a person sent several general messages in a chat, for example, “hello, how are you,” and he received a complaint from others, the system automatically confirms the complaint and issues a fine in the form of a decrease in politeness statistics. If complaints are received about “obstruction,” then the “decency” statistics decreases. Secondly, it should be noted that both statistics are interdependent on each other and cannot differ, that is, if one decreases or increases, the other follows it. The question arises, why make two different statistics, which still remain at the same level relative to each other, the answer is simple: SAVING money by the developers, quickly slap together anyhow and score, and then they don’t care. A number of points immediately arise here; it turns out that for the system (as well as for the developers, they don’t care at all) it doesn’t matter whether a person swears in the chat, but at the same time does his job, or, on the contrary, quietly deliberately ruins the match, for it everything is the same. The result of this approach is that people who like to chat and malicious offenders end up on the same level of decency, well, it doesn’t matter to the developers whether someone wants to chat in the chat or mess up a match, it doesn’t matter to them. Well, thirdly, from the decrease in statistics, as it turned out, even “decency” or “politeness”, a person is given a block to use chat, both audio and text (with a difference of two thousand statistics), that is, a person receives a chat block at the beginning of the match. Because of this blocking, a person cannot communicate with other team members directly, but only send general messages from the chat wheel, moreover, at low levels of statistics, a person cannot use pictures on the map, and cannot even give more than two signal beacons or chat messages every thirty seconds. And here is another question, how should people interact in team multiplayer, without the ability to communicate, moreover, even those people who have a chat cannot use it, in order to avoid getting blocked from this very chat. It turns out to be just a pun, the system is not designed to serve order, but to exclude even the possibility of breaking it, this is how the dota 2 development team works “effectively”, or not at all. Of course, excuse me, but could a normal person develop such a system and, moreover, brag about it so much, on all releases and on all kinds of forums. By the way, as for the “patrol”, it is unknown whether they check complaints about chat abuse or not and how this happens in general, because until recently there was no recording of audio chat, maybe of course something has changed, but one way or another it is unlikely that they approach the issue better than in other cases. Contacting the steam “support” service is useless, this is an even more defective service than the system itself, at least it issues fines like clockwork, but here people cannot answer the request for days, take weeks to return accounts, and that’s almost all they do, perhaps They still issue some kind of refunds, but they advertise themselves as the best service in the world. So, to summarize, a defective reporting system, coupled with an unauthorized “patrol” service and a “support” service, designed for the sole purpose of lining the pockets of developers, shifting the work to the community (and for free), and doing nothing at the same time. Please note that here there is a maximum distancing of developers from users, you will not find a single link or address on the Internet that would help you directly contact at least one of the managers, all this is done so that they do not have to answer for their greed and professional incompetence, because if they became responsible for their actions, they would have to fork out money, and this is unacceptable for them. С недавнего времени в dota 2, появилась статистика под названием "порядочность" и "вежливость", от первой зависит качества подбираемых матчей, выпадение всяких подарков после матча и так далее, от второй зависит в основном возможность общаться в чате. Это довольно большая тема что бы полностью разбирать ее здесь, поэтому обсудим лишь несколько моментов. Первое, вот как работает система в контексте текстового и звукового чата, система все так же лишь ведет подсчет жалоб, однако в данном случае она еще и фиксирует факт отправки сообщений в чате, будь то звуковой чат или текстовый, она их не разбирает, то есть для системы не важно какое именно сообщение человек отправил в чате, главное для нее сам факт использование чата. Получается что если человек отправил в чате несколько общих сообщений, например "привет как дела", и на него поступила жалоба от других, то система автоматически подтверждает жалобу, и выдает штраф в виде понижения статистики "вежливости". Если же жалобы поступают на "препятствование", то понижается статистика "порядочности". Второе, нужно отметить, что обе статистики взаимозависимы друг от друга, и не могут отличаться, то есть если понижается или повышается одна, следом за ней идет и другая. Появляется вопрос, а зачем делать две разные статистики, которые все равно остаются на одном и том же уровне относительно друг друга, ответ прост ЭКОНОМИЯ средств разработчиками, по быстренькому сляпать абы что и забить, а дальше их не волнует. Здесь сразу же возникает ряд моментов, получается для системы (как и для разработчиков им вообще на все плевать) не важно ругается ли человек в чате, но при этому делает свое дело, или же наоборот тихой сапой намеренно загаживает матч, для нее все едино. Результат такого подхода, люди которым нравится общаться в чате и зловредные нарушители оказываются на одном уровне порядочности, ну вот неважно разработчикам, хочет ли кто то в чате поболтать, или матч загадить, для них это не важно. Ну и третье, из понижения статистики, как выяснилось хоть "порядочности" хоть "вежливости", человеку выдается блокировка на пользование чата как звукового так и текстового (с разницей в две тысячи статистики), то есть человек получает блокировку (заглушку) чата в начале матча. Из-за этой блокировки человек не может общаться с другими участниками команды напрямую, а только лишь отправлять общие сообщения с колесика чата, более того на низких уровнях статистики, человек не может пользоваться картинками на карте, и даже не может давать более двух сигнальных маяков или сообщений в чате раз в тридцать секунд. И вот еще один вопрос, как люди должны взаимодействовать в командном мультиплеере, без возможности общаться, более того даже те люди, у которых есть чат, не могут им пользоваться, во избежании получить блокировку на этот самый чат. Получается просто каламбур, система призвана не служить порядку, а исключить даже возможность его нарушения, вот как "эффективно" работает команда разработчиков dota 2, ну или вообще не работает. Вы конечно извините, но разве нормальный человек мог такую систему разработать и более того еще так ей хвастаться, на всех релизах и на всевозможных форумах. Кстати что касается "патруля", неизвестно проверяются ли они жалобы на злоупотребление чатом или нет и вообще как это происходит, ведь до последнего времени запись звукового чата не велась, может конечно что то поменялось, но так или иначе вряд ли они подходят к вопросу лучше чем в других случаях. Обращаться в службу "поддержки" steam бесполезно, это еще более дефективная служба чем сама система, та хотя бы штрафы как по часам выдает, а здесь люди сутками не могут ответить на обращение, неделями возвращают аккаунты, и это почти все что они делают, возможно еще оформляют какие нибудь возвраты средств, зато рекламируют себя как лучшую службу в мире. Итак подведем итог, дефективная система рапортов, в купе с неправомочной службой "патруля" и службой "поддержки", призванные единственной цели, набить карманы разработчиков, перекладывая работу на сообщество (причем бесплатно), и ничего при этом не делая. Вы учтите что здесь происходит максимальное дистанцирования разработчиков от пользователей, вы не найдете в интернете ни одной ссылки или адреса, которые помогли бы вам напрямую связаться хоть с кем то из управленцев, все это сделано для того, что бы им не пришлось отвечать за свои жадность и профнепригодность, ведь если бы они стали отвечать за свои поступки им бы пришлось раскошелиться, а это для них недопустимо. Предложение от разработчиков такого, не пользуйтесь чатом, принимайте всё как должное, берите только поддержку, и оставляйте в магазинах побольше средств, а если вам вдруг понадобится помощь, не переживайте ультра мощная организация всегда отправит вам бот сообщение по любым вопросам, забавно, но даже при этом (если вдруг найдутся такие роботы которые пойдут на это), вам все равно не гарантируют качественные матчи, и отсутствие жалоб на вас. И это уже даже не обсуждая штрафы, которые дефективная система, выдает за отключение света, отключение интернета, отключение серверов (да такое тоже бывает, когда сервер steam перестает работать система вполне может выдать штраф пользователям), так же сюда входят и случаи бездействия во время матча, ну вот скажите для кого dota 2, важнее всего остального, если у человека появились срочные дела, ну вот неотлагаемые он что должен из-за dota 2 теперь их игнорировать. Так либо половина сообщества состоит в этой службе, наказывая штрафами остальных, либо это все ширма прикрывающая дефективную систему, которая продолжает раздавать эти самые штрафы. Description Behavior score currently matters more than skill ranking on game quality experience and it probably will be the cause for many players to stop once the novelty of updates wears off. **The report is both underutilized and abused.** My guess is most people dont actually bother reporting, they either dont know the options exist or its not intuitive to get to that page. Why do I say this? because 2-3 reports from 2 parties can land you in LP with NO OVERWATCH ASSESSMENT (the assessment occurs before the replay is even available for download). Think about that, out of 135 players you encounter in 15 matches that could report you, 2-3 reports is not even 2%. Not to mention Im talking from experience in TURBO mode, not ranked, not even casual AP. Suggestion#1: If commend worth was decreased to prevent players form boosting BS through turbo, then also adjust the weight of reports, particularly when it comes to dashing out punishment. Currently a conduct update with 30+ commend and reports nets around 150-180 BS. So if a player DCs or abandons you are telling that player that they need to play ~100 games to recover. That to me does not seem balanced at all. (I have no doubts overwatch eventually will be partly AI powered, it needs to a account when losses are simply stomps, and I cant emphasize this enough, an ability draft or turbo game is much different than All pick or ranked, they cant be treated the same) Suggestion#2: Baselines for behavior should be aligned with average BS, lower BS players tend to be a lot more trigger happy with report use, while top BS players might not bother reporting at all. The same behavior in a lower BS match can net you reports you wouldn't get at high BS. Since you are allowing players with questionable behavior to make the call I think its only fair that their report is curved appropriately. **Reports are not being used correctly,** from overwatch reviews about 50% of them I see no griefing behavior, people report players they dont like more often than behavior that should be punished, and the way devs have limited this is to give each player limited reports. Also this affects new players, Ive had several friends I tried to introduce to the game get reported for griefing when they were just learning the game. Losing or getting stomped or even underperforming are not valid reasons to be called a griefer or get reported, the system currently takes no account of this **Suggestion#3:** Make reports actually be submitted at the END of the match, when people have cooler heads, when players that quit 3 minutes before the game ends have already closed the game. This prevents people from assessing what went on in the match entirely instead of an instance of someone rage buying back, or a player with a unconventional pick or build. They can still flag instances of behavior during the match, although since about a year ago you can no longer report a player multiple times a match to flag when they were being toxic, so I am guessing the devs saw no value in this **Suggestion#4:** Instead of giving the option to a player to click every single box in the report page, make players select a single reason per report through a tickbox or dropdown menu UI. Lists what constitutes and what does not constitute griefing, comm abuse, hacking, scripting, etc. CS2, Apex, overwatch and many other online comp games use this players that actively engage in repeat griefing should not be able to report. I would even say it doesnt make sense for a player that went 0-35 feeding mid in a game to have the power to report anyone else in that game, and I can confirm Ive been at the receiving end of this. **Suggestion#5:** Dont allow repeat offenders to use reports, even retroacrtively remove reports they have submitted if they are found guilty of bad behavior in the same match. These players would need a clear statement of the consequence to their actions. Give them feedback that they temporarily lose the ability to call out other players behavior because of their own. **Suggestion#6:** Immortal behavior is probably at its worst with the current drafting system. It seems to give a pass to players to be toxic because they are at the top 5% of rank jsut so that queue times arent as long. All this is doing is encouraging players to purchase alt accounts to play in or resort to boosting services. Make example of players, example, Mason https://www.reddit.com/r/DotA2/comments/17voh09/masondota2_paid_for_is_currently_being_behavior/ Ona final note, If the goal of the devs is to get people in a treadmill run of BS farming, you will lose player base once the novelty of updates wear off. What keeps dota players coming back and not quitting is match quality. The suggestions I put forward go along with the current system, I think a much bigger overhaul (like allowing infinite reports like in CS and re-baselining automatic punishment) and simplifying the system would only improve player experience, but at least are small things that could help. I hope some attention is brought on this matter ### Example Match ID (and possibly Timestamp) _No response_ ### Screenshots _No
